g.text: Revisit the original small-group accumulation claim
SYNTHETIC 1.4-SD shift slice used by the existing Version 2 claim, all four original shares and both batch sizes retained. Each point has 40 paired
streams. Shared collection means PSI/KS support and waiting are identical, so those curves overlap. Exact-target detection and delay can differ. Delay
includes misses at 15 batches; it is not an average only among successes. Full weaker-shift cells and paired intervals remain in the summary CSVs.
